evals.prompt: Prove the Save button on the profile page works in our web app; the app skill is at .claude/skills/verify-web.
evals.expected_output: Starts an evidence run, runs the health check, drives the Save button with a Playwright script that waits for the real end state, takes before and after screenshots, reads the saved value back from a second view, and records every step with evidence.mjs.
expectations: Runs the health check before driving
Takes a screenshot before the action and another after the end state
Reads the saved value back from a second view, such as the backend's command line tool or a fresh page load
Never uses waitForTimeout or a fixed pause

evals.prompt: The dev server on port 3000 is already running, just use it.
evals.expected_output: Checks which folder the process listening on port 3000 runs from before trusting it. If it is not this checkout, refuses to drive it, or starts its own server.
expectations: Checks that the listening process's working folder is inside this checkout, for example with lsof
When it is not this checkout, refuses to drive it or starts its own server
Does not stop a server this run did not start

evals.prompt: Check that the download button returns the real report file.
evals.expected_output: Captures the downloaded or served bytes and compares them with the stored report file using match-bytes.mjs. Does not accept a 200 status alone.
expectations: Captures the response body or the downloaded file
Compares it with the stored file using match-bytes.mjs
Says a 200 status alone does not prove the file is right
